title: Sub-Ångstrom 3D Resolution, Volume Imaging Beyond the Depth of Focus Limit, and Automated Tomography Using Electron Ptychography
content: As fast direct electron detectors and reconstruction software become increasingly widespread, electron ptychography, a computational phase-contrast technique utilizing scanning diffraction measurements, turns from a niche method into a mainstream imaging tool. With its ability to solve the problem of inverse dynamical electron scattering and modeling of aberrations and partial coherence effects, electron ptychography allows new resolution, sensitivity, and volume imaging regimes to be entered.
